en:
Everyone seemed to really enjoy that
delicious-looking tripe hot pot...

It's fine. You do not need to worry about
me. *sigh*...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Keebo for a while?

Even if I can't eat, spending time together
during meals will strengthen our relationship.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Keebo, who tried
not to let his emotions show *too* much...
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
